sentences.en: The city is laid out regularly on a high, undulating prairie.

sentences.en: All were in excellent condition and she suspected that he probably used them regularly.

sentences.en: They had rated each other highly in the entanglement, and by mutual consent began repeat­ing the performance regularly.
